chapter: Early life and New Orleans arrival
title: Baby Seals and his published blues
summary: Discussion of Baby Seals' published pieces, their date and New Orleans phrases, and a return to Kennedy's 1906 concert.

Or My Money Ain't Gwine. And then Baby Seals Blues.

The Baby Seals Blues he published later, but I'm very sure he got, got his inspiration around New Orleans because there's a phrase or two in the Baby Seals Blues, which, which were, were common around New Orleans. You see, I forget what they are right now.
What's the period of Baby Seals?

Baby Seals was around 1910 or 12, along in there, like 1910, I think, was the, the piece, so that you got to shake, rattle and roll that he wrote, and the other came along right afterwards, but it was published up in Missouri, as I recollect.
